title: A Method for Stress Detection Using Empatica E4 Bracelet and Machine-Learning Techniques.
summary: Random-forest classification of Empatica E4-derived PPG/EDA features distinguished induced stress-task from rest segments in 29 laboratory participants, with reported accuracy of 76.5%. Random segment-level cross-validation was not subject-independent, so the result is preliminary and does not establish real-world stress detection. External replication and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
ai_technology: Random forest, SVM and logistic regression classify features from Empatica E4 PPG and electrodermal signals.
